data.name: Dinabandhu
data.short_meaning: Day giver, friend of the day
data.long_meaning: Dinabandhu is a name derived from Sanskrit roots 'dina' meaning 'day' and 'bandhu' meaning 'friend'. This name symbolizes one who is a giver of days, a friend to all on the daily basis.
